description: Return the published cross-source reconciliation group for a dataset name or id, including per-member counts, dates, statuses, tolerances, and contextual deltas. A discrepancy requires human review and does not prove either source is wrong. Use it to compare a dataset with its published cross-source group; do not use it for provenance or evidence receipts—use get_provenance or get_evidence instead. It reads precomputed reconciliation data, and single_source means no group contains the resolved dataset; DataPulse is read-only, requires no API key, and the edge limits clients to roughly one request per second with a small burst, so pace or retry.

dataset_name.description: Stable dataset slug or exact display name to resolve, e.g. 'interestrates' or 'Monthly Interest Rates'; use search_datasets to discover valid values.

verification.model: Signed probe attestation (Ed25519 L1, git-tag L2 anchor, per-dataset cosign keyless Sigstore bundle)
